caller_contract.source_compatibility: Exactly the existing six original analytic callers; deterministic core only needs η>0 and continuity of gradient for joint parameter continuity. No added probability, normalizer, path or regularity certificate.
caller_contract.space: {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

degenerate_cases.alpha_eta_one: No division by 1−αη or positive centered gap appears; αη=1 remains legal.
degenerate_cases.rank0: All vectors, gradients and norms vanish; flow is identity on singleton phase space and energy0. No Nontrivial/positive dimension binder.
degenerate_cases.zero_energy: Initial z=(c,0) is fixed and later rate-envelope can be0; must branch rather than divide by0.
degenerate_cases.zero_normal: Selected flow has no normal-denominator. Future bounce must use R0=id; h=0 ⇒ λ=0; no extra nonzero-normal premise.

minimality: One explicit deterministic-flow theorem edge, not all Proposition3.1. Bounce/rate and stochastic integrated-hazard construction remain separate options/consumers. No requirement to inherit unrelated polar/corrector twelve witnesses or invent a dependency on72 perturbation algebra.

reference_law_reuse.AffineGibbs.map_affine_gibbs: Already transports literal normalized Lebesgue tilt under nonzero affine scale, including rank0. No new law adapter needed.
reference_law_reuse.GaussianConditionalKernel.exists_tilted_: Arbitrary probability μ, positive η; produces every-y normalized tilt R, IsMarkovKernel and SAME J swapped disintegration. Do not replace by arbitrary supplied Q or rebuild normalizer/measurability.
reference_law_reuse.LiteralReflectedMean.reflected_gibbs_mea: Actual volume S_y equals every-y reflected posterior R_y pushforward and compact-observer C1 mean. Strong-convex Gibbs input and normalization are produced internally.
reference_law_reuse.timing: Reference sampling is used in full Algorithm1 after fixed-reference path construction; it is not a hypothesis needed for selected deterministic flow.

remaining_truth_boundary: No endpoint H or PDMP currently constructed by this package.
Flow maps alone do not prove existence, uniqueness, nonexplosion or stationarity of event-driven process.
Future bounce measurability must handle discontinuous h=0 branch, exact residual β-Lipschitzness produced from original Hessians.
Hazards must be integrable/continuous/nondecreasing, crossing times jointly Borel, clocks canonically realized.
Finite-jump recursion, almost-sure no accumulation, Markov property and path-reversal invariant law remain.
Only after that can actual terminal-position H_y, joint measurability, L2 operator/H1/B2/half-turn estimates and actual B4/B27 update be credited.
required_conclusion: For fixed η>0, (y,xRef,t,x,p) ↦ Φ_t^(y,xRef)(x,p) is jointly continuous and hence Borel; use actual gradient V, not an arbitrary caller-supplied center.
For every y,xRef,z and all real s,t, Φ_0(z)=z and Φ_(s+t)(z)=Φ_s(Φ_t(z)); thus Φ_(-t) is the same explicit inverse. Flow ℝ (E×E) packaging may reuse Mathlib.Flow rather than duplicate its structure.
For every real t and z=(x,p), HasDerivAt (fun s => (Φ_s z).1) (sqrt(η) • (Φ_t z).2) t and HasDerivAt (fun s => (Φ_s z).2) (−(sqrt(η))⁻¹ • ((Φ_t z).1−y) − sqrt(η) • gradient V xRef) t.
For every real t,z, H(Φ_t z)=H(z), with H≥0. The norm is the explicit weighted SUM of two squared E norms, never the standard product max norm.
For every z=(x,p), Φ_π(z)=((2:ℝ) • c−x,−p); the position is independent of the temporary momentum at π.
source_first_derivation_plan: Set a=(x−c)/sqrt(η); the explicit formulas become a_t=cos(t)•a+sin(t)•p, p_t=−sin(t)•a+cos(t)•p.
Use η>0 to identify sqrt(η)^2=η and its nonzero reciprocal; no dimension or spectral assumption is needed.
Use source C2 gradient continuity and scalar/vector operations for joint continuity.
Use sine/cosine addition for group and zero formulas; source ODE derivatives follow from actual formula derivatives.
Expand both squared norms; mixed inner terms cancel and sin²+cos²=1 gives H invariance.
Evaluate at π using sinπ=0, cosπ=−1.
